sentences.en: Peasants often have a secondary activity to augment their income.
sentences.zh: 农民常常有其他副业来增加收入。

sentences.en: This technology is called augmented reality.
sentences.zh: 这项技术被称为增强现实。

sentences.en: Jugurtha sought to augment his power.
sentences.zh: 朱古达企图扩大自己的权力。

phrases.zh: 增强现实：指在真实世界的基础上叠加虚拟信息的技术。
